Descripción del puesto

Remote LATAM Sales Development Representative role making outbound cold calls to qualify leads and set appointments, paying $6 USD/hour plus $25 USD per appointment.

Funciones principales

  • Make outbound cold calls to identify and qualify leads.
  • Set appointments and generate pipeline opportunities for the sales team.
  • Log daily activity in CRM tools and collaborate on outreach strategies.

Requisitos

  • 2+ years of outbound cold calling experience (required); B2B is a plus.
  • Fluent English (C1 level) and based in LATAM.
  • Proficiency with CRM systems and Microsoft Suite.

Beneficios

  • $6 USD/hour base pay + $25 USD commission per appointment.
  • 10 days PTO per year + paid US holidays.
  • 100% remote with long-term growth opportunities.
